item_name: Transfusions (O0110I1) — Special Treatments, Procedures, and Programs

lookback_source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

lookback_notes: O0110 uses column-specific assessment periods rather than a single window: Column a. On Admission = days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B; Column b. While a Resident = the last 14 days (after admission/entry or reentry); Column c. At Discharge = the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C. The 14-day period recorded in lookback_days is the 'While a Resident' observation window; the two 3-day windows are also stated on p. O-1 and p. O-3.

coding_levels.label: Transfusions — On Admission
coding_levels.definition: Check if transfusions were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

coding_levels.label: Transfusions — While a Resident
coding_levels.definition: Check if transfusions were received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

coding_levels.label: Transfusions — At Discharge
coding_levels.definition: Check if transfusions were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

coding_levels.label: None of the above
coding_levels.definition: If no treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed in the applicable assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote:
O0110Z1, None of the above
Code if none of the above treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed by the resident.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code transfusions of blood or any blood products (e.g., platelets, synthetic blood products) that are administered directly into the bloodstream in this item.

source.quote: Code transfusions of blood or any blood products (e.g., platelets, synthetic blood products), that are administered directly into the bloodstream in this item.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Do not include transfusions that were administered during dialysis or chemotherapy.

source.quote: Do not include transfusions that were administered during dialysis or chemotherapy.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Blood transfusions administered during chemotherapy are not recorded under O0110I (Transfusions).

source.quote: IVs, IV medication, and blood transfusions administered during chemotherapy are not recorded under items K0520A (Parenteral/IV), O0110H (IV Medications), or O0110I (Transfusions).

federal_coding_rules.rule: Blood transfusions administered during dialysis are considered part of the dialysis procedure and are not to be coded under O0110I (transfusions).

source.quote: IVs, IV medication, and blood transfusions administered during dialysis are considered part of the dialysis procedure and are not to be coded under items K0520A (Parenteral/IV), O0110H (IV medications), or O0110I (transfusions).

federal_coding_rules.rule: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff.

source.quote: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure; surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

source.quote: Do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators. Surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Transfusions (O0110I1) may be checked in all three columns: a. On Admission, b. While a Resident, and c. At Discharge.
If no treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed in the applicable assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed in the 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

federal.criterion: Review the resident's medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed any of the treatments, procedures, or programs within the assessment period defined for each column.

source.quote: Review the resident's medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed any of the treatments, procedures, or programs within the assessment period defined for each column.

federal.notes: Stated as the single Step for Assessment for O0110.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The pages describing O0110I do not tie this item to a payment or case-mix classification. Assessment periods reference SNF PPS Stay dates (A2400B/A2400C), but no payment/case-mix impact is stated for this item in the supplied pages.

conflicts.topic: Multiple assessment windows for O0110 (3 days on admission, 14 days while a resident, 3 days at discharge)

positions.claim: The item table states three distinct assessment periods by column: days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay (On Admission), performed while a resident within the last 14 days (While a Resident), and the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay (At Discharge).

source.quote: Assessment period is days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B

positions.claim: The Item Rationale refers to a single "14-day look-back period" for the treatments, procedures, and programs in O0110.

source.quote: Reevaluation of special treatments and procedures the resident received or performed, or programs that the resident was involved in during the 14-day look-back period is important to ensure the continued appropriateness of the treatments, procedures, or programs.

conflicts.resolution: unresolved — surface to user; the coding instructions on p. O-3 define a distinct assessment period per column, while the rationale on p. O-2 refers generally to a 14-day look-back period.
